items.title: On-campus: aasaan shuruaat
items.detail: Campus paas, setup simple. Aksar jaldi apply karna padta hai.

items.title: Off-campus: zyada options
items.detail: Rent aur location compare karo. Flatmates ke saath kharcha baant sakte ho.

items.title: Lease dhyan se padho
items.detail: Deposit, notice period aur bills kiske zimme hain, sab likha hona chahiye.

items.title: Scam se bacho
items.detail: Bina dekhe ya bina contract ke advance paisa mat bhejo.

youtube.title: Abroad mein rehna kahan hai? On-campus vs off-campus
youtube.description:
On-campus housing mein shuruaat aasaan hoti hai, off-campus mein zyada options. Lease dhyan se padho aur bina contract ke advance paisa kabhi mat bhejo.
